thread:
priya: Quick sync: new idea for Data-CP enrollment to avoid inbound changes for customers. Outline: install operator -> generate CSR+key -> outbound enroll -> receive cert+policy -> establish mTLS websocket to relays. open Qs: attestation, revocation, policy ttl.

ashwin: +1, but we must keep Data-CP minimal: routing pointers, tokens, prefix cache only. no model artifacts. add signed tombstones for cache invalidation.

leo: routing options: outbound websocket relays (multiplex), PrivateLink (expensive), or ephemeral peering (scales poorly). leaning to outbound multiplexed relays.

maya: security: customer-managed KMS or short-lived certs; need attestation path.

sam: call this pattern "hybrid-control" and treat pure private-hosting separately.

priya: I'll draft the RFC section. can we keep notes about rollback/canary?

ashwin: include versioned enroll API and cert protocol versioning.

leo: I'll spike relay multiplex perf next week.
